_help: clis: how to run each agent CLI. {model} is replaced. Every command must start a new session and keep none (codex --ephemeral, claude --no-session-persistence, pi --no-session): agents of different tickets never share a session. auth = login files under AUTH_HOME (mounted into the sandbox). env = API keys or tokens that also count as a login (set them with ff login). check = command that exits 0 when logged in. quota = which subscription gate applies. lanes: one ordered chain per agent (agents/<name>.md), or an alias to another agent's chain. Chains are ordered '<cli>:<model>' chains, cheapest or preferred first. gates: quota limits in percent.
_help_pinned: pinned agents always start at the first entry of their chain: Jev does not move them.
_help_gates: Quota gates. codex: skip at 5h_max / 7d_max percent used. cursor: skip at bucket_max percent. opencode-go has no usage endpoint, so the router counts the factory's own calls: skip at 5h_budget calls in 5 hours (set it to your plan's limit). A list inside a chain = routes to the same model; the one with the most quota left wins.
